# Methods

Six published methods, each ported stage by stage and checked against its reference code, the same weights loaded into both. For GSNet, the reference code is a third-party implementation ([graspnet/graspness_unofficial](https://github.com/graspnet/graspness_unofficial)). Five share the seed-based skeleton and its slots; HGGD reads RGB-D images and is a family of its own.

## Seed-based skeleton · 5 methods

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

-   **[GraspNet-baseline](graspnet_baseline.md)** · CVPR 2020 · depth

    ---

    The baseline released with GraspNet-1Billion: PointNet++ seeds, 300 views, four depths.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the authors&#x27; code, the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_baseline_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="the authors&#x27; checkpoint, converted and scored on whole test splits; nothing trained here yet">authors&#x27; weights scored here</span>

-   **[GSNet](gsnet.md)** · ICCV 2021 · depth

    ---

    Graspness-guided seeds on a sparse U-Net, one of 300 views, a grid of angles and depths.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the reference implementation (graspness_unofficial, third-party), the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_gsnet_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="a model trained by GraspPanda, scored on whole test splits">trained here</span>

-   **[Scale-Balanced-Grasp](scale_balanced_grasp.md)** · CoRL 2022 · depth

    ---

    Small grasps not drowned out: four crop radii and width-balanced losses.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the authors&#x27; code, the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_sbg_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="the authors&#x27; checkpoint, converted and scored on whole test splits; nothing trained here yet">authors&#x27; weights scored here</span>

-   **[EconomicGrasp](economicgrasp.md)** · ECCV 2024 · depth

    ---

    One compact label per point and view; a head that classifies angle, depth and quality.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the authors&#x27; code, the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_economicgrasp_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="the authors&#x27; checkpoint, converted and scored on whole test splits; nothing trained here yet">authors&#x27; weights scored here</span>

-   **[FineGrasp](finegrasp.md)** · arXiv 2025 · depth

    ---

    Surface normals as input, graspness per object, four crop radii fused by attention.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the authors&#x27; code, the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_finegrasp_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="the authors&#x27; checkpoint, converted and scored on whole test splits; nothing trained here yet">authors&#x27; weights scored here</span>

## Own family

<div class="grid cards" markdown>

-   **[HGGD](hggd.md)** · RA-L 2023 · RGB-D

    ---

    A 2-D heat-map of grasp centres, completed in 3-D by a PointNet over local regions.

    <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="stage by stage against the authors&#x27; code, the same weights loaded into both: tests/integration/test_hggd_parity.py">equal to the reference ✓</span> <span class="gp-chip gp-chip--ok" title="the authors&#x27; checkpoint, converted and scored on whole test splits; nothing trained here yet">authors&#x27; weights scored here</span>
